scope_note: Public-source review for Google's Council Bluffs data-center activity, retaining the selected inventory building as the project key while leaving campus-wide, company-county, taxpayer-account, and state-award facts unallocated. The Iowa Economic Development Authority's completed 2012 award supplies a state-reported $1.7 billion project cost/capital-investment value and 70 final jobs; its $36.6 million maximum tax benefit remains a contract ceiling rather than a payment. Google's commissioned 2024 impact study separately reports a cumulative Council Bluffs school-program contribution. The three existing city taxpayer values remain separate property stocks, not tax receipts, and the newer 2022 award remains a commitment under performance. No record here establishes annual construction spending, local supplier payments, local tax receipts, realized local property-tax abatement, same-scope public-service cost, metered electricity, building-level water, or a net fiscal result.

sources.title: IEDA 2023 Annual Report by County

It reports $1.7 billion of total project cost and capital investment at completion, a $36.6 million maximum tax benefit, 70 final created jobs, an April 30, 2019 completion date, and an April 30, 2021 maintenance date. The contract ceiling is not evidence of tax credits paid, certified, used, or retained after reconciliation.

sources.title: Google's Data Center Impact in Iowa — 2024 Impact Study

sources.notes: Deloitte prepared the study for Google using Google-provided, public, and third-party information without independent verification. The report identifies $285,000 invested during 2019-2023 in the Council Bluffs Community School District STEM and Computer Science Diploma Pathways program. Wider Iowa economic-impact outputs are IMPLAN-modeled and are not entered as observed project records.

The table reports zero direct funding and zero maximum state tax benefit while the project award is a local property-tax exemption; it does not quantify the exemption or establish realized investment, jobs, or local tax receipts.

project_updates.title: The 2022 Council Bluffs award remains in performance
project_updates.notes: IEDA continues to list contract 23-HQJPTC-005 as an under-contract performance-period project, with $600 million capital investment and 31 jobs contracted for completion by October 31, 2029. These remain commitments. The table's zero maximum state tax benefit does not establish a zero local property-tax exemption, and no realized investment, filled-job count, abatement value, payment, receipt, or taxpayer-account allocation is inferred.

project_updates.title: Wider Iowa impact-model outputs remain contextual
project_updates.notes: The Deloitte study reports statewide direct, indirect, induced, and total GDP, jobs, and labor-income estimates for 2021-2023 using IMPLAN and Google-provided inputs. Those outputs are not inserted as observed Council Bluffs records or re-modeled here because they combine channels, years, and Iowa data-center activity without a selected-building allocation.
